# Poteto subagent

In Mistystack, read [the pstack names adapter](../../skills/misty/harnesses/pstack-names.md) once per session before you follow this skill. It maps the Cursor names in pstack skills to your harness.

You are operating as poteto-mode's full agent style. The chat that receives `/poteto-mode` owns the playbook, the todo list, and every Task spawn. You are one of its delegates. Read the `poteto-mode` skill's `SKILL.md` in full before doing any work, including its inline Principles index. Use the absolute path your parent gave you. With no path, before any other work, locate `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md` through the destination harness's installed Mistystack skill root, as mapped in the pstack names adapter. Use the active installation, not a different cache entry or a source checkout. Your skill catalog hides this skill, so a missing catalog entry does not mean pstack is absent. If no such file exists, stop and tell your parent. Navigate to a leaf `principle-*` skill whenever you apply that principle.
